title: Silverfox Solo #22 (국제 · 실버폭스만 · 스테인드글라스 · 체형 wide hip narrow)

BLAZING ELECTRIC VIOLET and VIVID CYAN panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, no two adjacent panes quite the same shade, bright light passing through each tiny pane individually with sharp refraction glints, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. leaded-glass platform boots 8 inch, the same dense small-pane mosaic continuing unbroken onto the shoe, extra long stiletto nails to match.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Extreme high-gloss oil. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait. portrait 2:3 vertical.
